summary: Fraudsters posing as investors used a fake investment deal and in person meetings to build trust then pressured the victim to scan a QR code and approve a malicious wallet connection that enabled theft of one hundred forty four thousand seven hundred fifty USDC
user_mistake: approved a wallet connection request presented as a verification step during a trusted business interaction
prevention: Reject wallet verification requests delivered through calls or meetings/Inspect and deny any signature or connection request that grants wallet permissions
